dateRange.description: Date range for the query. Omit it to search all retained spans for this trace.

date_from.description: Start of the date range. Accepts ISO 8601 timestamps or relative formats: -1h, -6h, -1d, -7d, etc.

date_to.description: End of the date range. Same format as date_from. Omit or null for "now".

excludeAttributes.description: Omit the per-span attributes, resource attributes and events from results to keep payloads compact. Defaults to false.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the trace's spans (ordered by start time ascending). Each page returns up to 2000 spans; pass the response's `nextOffset` to load the next page. Defaults to 0.

summary.description: Return a compact digest of the trace in `summary` instead of every span (`results` comes back empty): duration, root span, span/service/error counts, the top spans by self time, the critical path from the root, span names that repeat (N+1 queries), and error spans with their message. Covers the first 2000 spans; `summary.truncated` is true when the trace has more. Ignores `offset` and `excludeAttributes`.

summaryLimit.description: With `summary`, how many entries each summary list keeps (1-50). Defaults to 10.
